name: @fhevm/forge-fhevm-std-dev
description: Dev package for forge-fhevm-std. Never published. The published package is ./pkg.

scripts.build: npm run fmt:check && npm run lint && npm run compile
scripts.clean:generated: npm run clean:generate:forge-payload && npm run clean:generate:version
scripts.fmt: npm run prettier:write && npm run forge:fmt
scripts.fmt:check: npm run prettier:check && npm run forge:fmt:check
scripts.generate: npm run generate:pre && npm run compile:forge && npm run generate:post
scripts.generate:pre: npm run generate:forge-payload && npm run generate:version
scripts.test:anvil: sh -c 'anvil --silent --port 8546 & P=$!; sleep 1; ANVIL_RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8546 forge test --match-path "test/anvil/*"; S=$?; kill $P; exit $S'
